Subject: Your cheque bounce matter - CC/1880/2025

Dear Ms. Tiwari,

Thank you for meeting us on 25 November 2025 about your dispute with M/s Trident Enterprises. As we understand it, the cheque was dishonoured because the signature did not match. The matter is listed before the Judicial Magistrate First Class Court at Thane.

Our advice is to obtain the bank's certificate on the signature mismatch and treat it as a dishonour under the cheque-bounce law. Please collect the bank's certificate on the signature mismatch and the drawer's earlier cheques and send copies to this office.

Regards,
Adv. Kunal Bhagat

spans.text: Judicial Magistrate First Class Court at Thane
